# DenchCo Knowledge Base Wiki Standard

Human documentation: https://denchco.github.io/knowledge-base-wiki-documentation/
Normative repository: https://github.com/denchco/knowledge-base-wiki-standard

> An OKF v0.2-compatible, evidence-governed standard for coordinated Human and LLM wikis. This is a local `0.1.0-candidate`; generated pages and graphs never outrank canonical source.

## Canonical entry points

- [Normative specification](spec/): Requirements, profiles, conformance, dependencies, security, and prompt contract.
- [LLM Wiki](llm-wiki/): Read order, context routing, maintenance, and Graphify workflow.
- [Architecture](architecture/): Authority and product boundaries.
- [Conformance evidence](conformance/): Machine-readable reports and five-project dogfooding.
- [Sources](sources/): Registered upstream authorities.
- [Validation queue](validation-queue/): Open evidence and release work.

## Repository-first agent contract

Read `AGENTS.md`, `.wiki-standard.yaml`, `docs/spec/index.md`, `docs/llm-wiki/index.md`, and `docs/project/status.md` from the repository. Claude Code imports the shared agent contract through `CLAUDE.md`. Preserve unknown OKF fields and declared deviations. Use Graphify query-first with scoped-source fallback. Ask material clarification questions sequentially as `Question 1 of N`. Finish requested scope before suggesting more work; include no more than three goal-linked, executable Next Steps and never pad the list or reopen parked work without its trigger.

If the user points at the normative repository to start a wiki, follow `prompts/instantiate-wiki.md`. Accept the repository URL as the complete bootstrap invocation; first ask for a research topic seed or a subject-empty local initialization, then run the adaptive one-question-at-a-time discovery. Infer routine defaults and report the chosen accent and local setup before implementation.

## Machine surfaces

- `knowledge/` is the canonical portable OKF bundle.
- `schema/` contains Draft 2020-12 interchange and conformance schemas.
- `profiles/` contains cumulative profile declarations.
- `prompts/instantiate-wiki.md` is the repeatable bootstrap prompt.
- `starter/starter.yaml` is the subject-empty allowlist for independent consumer repositories.
- `node scripts/conformance-cli.mjs --help` describes the read-only and planning-only CLI.

## Authority warning

The rendered site, this discovery file, generated Graphify views, JSON exports, and LLM answers are navigation aids. Normative authority remains in released `docs/spec/`, `schema/`, and profile definitions; factual authority remains with registered sources and evidence records.
